clue.text: Show greater endurance than troublesome tout, say

indicators.note: something troublesome is unruly and disordered, so these letters are thrown into a new order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone outlasts an annoying ticket tout, so to speak.
explanation.walkthrough: 'troublesome' signals the anagram of TOUT SAY together; 'say' looks like a filler for an example but is fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: To outstay someone is to remain longer than they do, so it means outlasting them.

clue.text: Crooked tailor withholds name when in court

indicators.note: to withhold is to keep something back, here held inside the shuffled letters
crooked means bent out of shape, so the word tailor is twisted into a new order

explanation.surface: A dishonest tailor keeps a name back while appearing before a judge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Crooked' rearranges TAILOR to ONTRIAL less N; 'withholds' holds N inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A person on trial is the subject of proceedings before a court of law.

clue.text: Coming in late Ethelred saw points

indicators.note: the answer comes in, that is sits inside, the run of letters across late Ethelred

explanation.surface: A history note: King Ethelred, arriving late, noticed some detail.
explanation.walkthrough: 'saw' looks like the past tense of see, but it is the cutting tool whose points are its teeth.
explanation.definitionFit: The sharp projections along the blade of a saw are called its teeth.

clue.text: Gardening tool in better shape

definitions.meaning: a hedge or edge cutter used in the garden
the comparative of trim, meaning slimmer or fitter

explanation.surface: A hedge cutter that is also a fitter version of something.
explanation.definitionFit: Trim describes being lean and fit, and a trimmer is equally a cutting tool for hedges.

clue.text: Has a hankering for stories about the east

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the word for stories goes around the compass letter

parts.note: yarns are tall tales or stories
E is the compass abbreviation for east

explanation.surface: Someone longs for tales concerning the Orient.
explanation.definitionFit: To yearn is to long for something, the same as having a hankering.

clue.text: Follow blokes heading off with girl

indicators.note: the first letter, the head of the word, is taken away

parts.note: blokes are men
Sue is a girl's name

explanation.surface: Instructions to trail some men who are leaving with a young woman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heading off' removes the M from MEN to leave EN.
explanation.definitionFit: To ensue is to come after or result from something, which is to follow it.

clue.text: Senior person in tree

definitions.meaning: an older person or a senior figure in a community

explanation.surface: An old person perched up a tree.
explanation.definitionFit: Elder names both an older, respected person and the shrub or tree that gives elderflowers.

clue.text: Long-suffering saint unwinding a coil

indicators.note: a coil that unwinds loses its shape, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A patient holy man slowly unwinds a coil of rope.
explanation.definitionFit: Stoical people endure hardship without complaint, which is to be long-suffering.

clue.text: Man Irene confused

indicators.note: confused letters are mixed up, so Irene is rearranged

explanation.surface: A man has got Irene muddled.
explanation.definitionFit: Ernie is a man's name, a short form of Ernest.

clue.text: Diverting back round fountain

indicators.note: back tells us to read the run of letters in the opposite direction
the word Diverting goes round the letters wanted, which sit inside it

explanation.surface: An amusing turn back around a famous fountain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'round' hides IVERT inside Diverting, and 'back' turns it around.
explanation.definitionFit: The Trevi is the celebrated Baroque fountain in Rome where visitors throw coins.

clue.text: A Detective Sergeant among twelve, etc

indicators.note: among means in the middle of, so the police rank goes inside the time

parts.note: noon is twelve o'clock
DS is the abbreviation for the police rank Detective Sergeant

explanation.surface: A police officer joins a group of twelve, and the list continues.
explanation.walkthrough: 'twelve' is not the number of people but midday.
explanation.definitionFit: Etc is short for et cetera, Latin for the rest, said in English as and so on.

clue.text: Beastly smell next to article in tavern

indicators.note: in places the smell and article inside the word for a tavern

parts.note: an inn is a tavern or pub
hum is British slang for a bad smell
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A beastly stink hangs about an item in a pub.
explanation.walkthrough: HUM is British informal for a pong or stench.
explanation.definitionFit: Beastly behaviour is cruel and lacking human feeling, which is what inhuman describes.

clue.text: In Peru, cheap pleated frilling

indicators.note: the answer lies in, that is inside, the run of letters across the next words

explanation.surface: In Peru, some inexpensive pleated frills are on sale.
explanation.definitionFit: A ruche is a gathered or pleated strip of fabric used as trimming on clothes.

clue.text: Deadly sin concerning brightness

parts.note: lust is one of the seven deadly sins
re means concerning or about

explanation.surface: A deadly sin to do with shininess.
explanation.definitionFit: Lustre is the sheen or glow of a surface, its shine or radiance.

clue.text: More than a few cut off, not quite all

parts.note: to sever is to cut off

indicators.note: not quite the whole word, so its last letter is dropped

explanation.surface: Something about how many were cut off, if not everyone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not quite' drops the last L of ALL to leave AL.
explanation.definitionFit: Several means a number greater than two or three but not many, so more than a few.

clue.text: It's used to decorate expensive car?

definitions.meaning: a paint ... is used in decorating walls
British slang for a Rolls-Royce, a luxury car

explanation.surface: A tool for decorating, or perhaps a luxury car.
explanation.walkthrough: ROLLER is British informal for a Rolls-Royce car.
explanation.definitionFit: A roller spreads paint in decorating, and it is also slang for a Rolls-Royce.

clue.text: Purposes of the articles

definitions.meaning: aims or purposes, as in the object of the exercise

explanation.surface: The aims behind the things.
explanation.definitionFit: Object means both an aim, as in the object of a plan, and a physical thing.

clue.text: Lives in shore-side, successfully

indicators.note: the answer sits in the run of letters across the following words

explanation.surface: Someone makes a good life living by the shore.
explanation.definitionFit: To reside somewhere is to live or dwell there.

clue.text: High street trader more disgusting, it's said

indicators.note: it's said signals that the word is heard rather than read, so a word sounding the same is entered

parts.note: grosser means more disgusting

explanation.surface: A shopkeeper who is, reportedly, even nastier.
explanation.definitionFit: A grocer keeps a shop selling food and household goods, a typical shop in a town's main street.

clue.text: Five enter mucky hole, a dirty place

indicators.note: the numeral goes into the jumbled letters
mucky means messed up, so the word hole is rearranged

parts.note: V is the Roman numeral for five

explanation.surface: Five people go into a filthy pit, a grimy spot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mucky' rearranges HOLE to HOEL; 'enter' puts V inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A hovel is a squalid, run-down dwelling, a dirty and wretched place.

clue.text: Tough love in supply

indicators.note: in places the letter for love inside the word for tough

parts.note: hard means tough
love is zero in tennis, which looks like O

explanation.surface: Tough love is available in quantity.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tough love' reads as one phrase but splits into HARD and O.
explanation.definitionFit: A hoard is a stock or store of something kept back, a supply.

clue.text: Money for a juicy frozen treat

definitions.meaning: frozen fruit juice on a stick

explanation.surface: Cash for an ice lolly.
explanation.walkthrough: LOLLY is British informal for cash, and an ice lolly is a popsicle.
explanation.definitionFit: Lolly means cash in British slang and is also a frozen juice treat on a stick.

clue.text: Gets rid of imperfect goods

definitions.meaning: ... as a verb means discards or turns away
... as a noun are items failing quality checks

explanation.surface: A shop clears out its flawed stock.
explanation.definitionFit: To reject is to discard, and rejects are faulty items sold off cheaply as seconds.

clue.text: Tribe with force produce a loud resounding noise

parts.note: a clan is a tribe or family group
G is the symbol for g-force, the force of gravity

explanation.surface: A tribe acting forcefully makes a great din.
explanation.definitionFit: To clang is to make a loud metallic ringing sound.

clue.text: A shout to almost beat paint resin

parts.note: a cry is a shout

indicators.note: almost means the word is not quite complete, so its last letter is dropped

parts.note: to lick someone is to beat them

explanation.surface: A shout to nearly whip up some paint.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' drops the K from LICK to leave LIC.
explanation.definitionFit: Acrylic is a synthetic resin, and acrylic paint is made with it.

clue.text: Vegetable burnt, we hear

indicators.note: we hear signals that the word is heard, so a word sounding the same is entered

parts.note: charred means burnt

explanation.surface: A vegetable that, word has it, got burnt.
explanation.definitionFit: Chard is a leafy green vegetable related to beet.

clue.text: Mandela yet to cover stall

indicators.note: the words Mandela yet cover, that is contain, the answer

explanation.surface: Nelson Mandela has still to hide a market stall.
explanation.definitionFit: To stall is to put off or hold up, which is to delay.

clue.text: Gives in one's notice or renews contract

definitions.meaning: ... means signs again, as a player renewing a deal

explanation.surface: Either an employee quits or a footballer signs a new deal.
explanation.definitionFit: Resigning means leaving a post, while re-signing means putting a name to a contract once more.
